privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data PRODET TUNISIE collects via www.prodet.com.tn, why, for how long, with whom, and what your rights are. It applies under Tunisian Law No. 2004-63 and GDPR-aligned practice.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: PRODET TUNISIE (SARL), 20 Rue de Somalie, Cité El Bassatine, L’Aouina 2045, Tunisia.
Contact: contact@prodet.com.tn — Phone: 71 758 468.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Via contact and quote forms: name or company name, business email, phone, message, requested products and quantities.
Via the client portal (accounts activated by Prodet): login email, request history and documents linked to the account.
Technical browsing data: page views, referrer, approximate country, device type — via Vercel Web Analytics, without advertising profiling cookies.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes
paragraphs: Respond to quote and contact requests.
Manage the B2B commercial relationship and client-portal access.
Improve the site (anonymous or aggregated audience statistics).
Secure the service (abuse prevention, technical logging).

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis and retention
paragraphs: Contact and quote data are kept as long as needed to handle the request, then for the duration of the commercial relationship, and longer when required by law (including accounting and commercial obligations).
Client-account data are kept while the account is active, then archived or deleted according to operational and legal needs.
Technical logs and audience metrics follow the retention periods of the relevant providers.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Data are accessible to authorised PRODET TUNISIE staff.
Technical providers: Vercel (site hosting), Supabase (database and authentication in the European Union), and where needed transactional email tools required to process requests.
We do not sell your data or use it for third-party behavioural advertising.

sections.heading: 6. Transfers
paragraphs: The site runs on European infrastructure for the application and database. Some providers (including the hosting platform vendor) may be established outside Tunisia; appropriate contractual safeguards are applied where required.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Under Law No. 2004-63 you may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction of processing, and object to certain processing, within the limits of the law.
To exercise these rights: contact@prodet.com.tn. We respond as soon as possible and within the legally applicable deadline.
You may also contact the Instance Nationale de Protection des Données Personnelles (INPDP) in case of dispute.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures (HTTPS, access control, input validation, logging of sensitive admin actions) to protect data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
paragraphs: Details of cookies and audience measurement are on the [[Cookies|/cookies]] page.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: This page describes cookies and audience measurement on www.prodet.com.tn.

sections.heading: 1. No advertising cookies
paragraphs: The site does not use advertising, remarketing or third-party profiling cookies (no Google Analytics, no ad pixels).

sections.heading: 2. Audience measurement
paragraphs: We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page views and understand site usage (pages, countries, referrers). This measurement is designed to work without advertising tracking cookies.
This information is used only to improve the site and is not sold.

sections.heading: 3. Technical / session cookies
paragraphs: Strictly necessary cookies or storage may be used for site operation (for example chosen language, or client-portal session after login).
Without these, some features (client login, language preference) may not work correctly.

sections.heading: 4. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can configure your browser to refuse or delete cookies. Blocking technical cookies may limit access to the client portal.
Questions: contact@prodet.com.tn. See also the [[Privacy policy|/confidentialite]].
